title: Porosity
description: Volume not occupied by solid material

components.content:
## Porosity Calculator

Porosity is expressed as the volume not occupied by solid material:

**n = Vv / V**

**n = 1 - ρbulk / ρsolid**

Where:
- **n** = porosity (dimensionless)
- **Vv** = void volume (m³, ft³)
- **V** = total volume (m³, ft³)
- **ρbulk** = bulk density (kg/m³, slugs/ft³)
- **ρsolid** = solid density (kg/m³, slugs/ft³)
